story: A five-man breakaway split on the first ascent of the Alto do Malhão, leaving Julian Alaphilippe and Maximilian Schachmann out front before Schachmann crashed. Florian Lipowitz and Kévin Vauquelin later bridged across, but the race regrouped ahead of the finale. João Almeida set the pace, as Juan Ayuso overtook Oscar Onley at the line to claim stage and overall victory.
